terrain.headline_source: Estimate assumes dealers long calls, short puts (SqueezeMetrics 2017), the convention least reliable for single stocks (Garleanu, Pedersen & Poteshman 2009). Swings: Ni, Pearson, Poteshman & White, RFS 2021; Amaya, Garcia-Ares, Pearson & Vasquez 2025.
